Name: Patios (PIF)
Author: Sharogg
Description:
This mod adds four different patios as small, decoratable outdoor areas for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF - Personal Rooms[/url]. 

[b]Forest Patio[/b][list]
[*]Patio area with changeable floor
[*]a bit of farmable land in forest setting
[/list][b]River Patio[/b][list]
[*]Patio area with changeable floor
[*]a bit of farmable land with a river running through
[*]catch forest fish
[/list]
[b]Beach Patio[/b][list]
[*]Patio area with changeable floor
[*]ocean and beach (not walkable)
[*]catch ocean fish
[/list]
[b]Mountain Patio[/b][list]
[*]Patio area with changeable floor
[*]a bit of farmable land on some cliffs
[*]dynamic MMAP panorama (Sharogg's Panoramas required!)
[/list]
The panorama may not display correctly if you're playing on a very high resolution/are very far zoomed out (75% zoom on 1080p is fine)

[b]Installation[/b]
Unzip the mod and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder. Requires SMAPI,
Content Patcher, PIF and Sharogg's Tilesheets. 1.6. is required.

You don't need MMAP/Sharogg's Panoramas if you don't want to use the mountain patio, but there will probably be error messages showing up. The other patios should not be impacted from this.
